steps.en: Scaffold and start a Node.js Starter site
steps.zh: 生成并启动 Node.js Starter 站点

steps.en: Open the admin, name the site, and register an administrator passkey
steps.zh: 打开后台，填写站点信息并注册管理员通行密钥

steps.en: Apply the Starter content model and sample posts to SQLite
steps.zh: 把模板的内容模型和示例文章写入 SQLite

steps.en: Edit the Welcome post and publish the changes
steps.zh: 修改 Welcome 文章并发布

steps.en: Render the published version on the next home-page request
steps.zh: 在下次首页请求中呈现已发布版本

value.en: Editors publish to your Astro site without a code commit or content rebuild
value.zh: 编辑无需提交代码或重新构建内容，就能在 Astro 站点发布
